scope: Solar (heliospheric) modulation of galactic cosmic rays in the force-field approximation, by reference to the hep-measurement force-field script (not reimplemented): the force-field solution derived and checked in SymPy, its validity range and known limits with sources, and a closed-form benchmark of a power-law local interstellar spectrum modulated in total kinetic energy, kinetic energy per nucleon and rigidity against the script. Convection-diffusion, drift and 1D-3D numerical models, the neutron-monitor link and multi-period phi fits are documented only.
exclusions: Any numerical heliospheric transport, drift, or charge-sign dependent modulation model (documented, not run)
Reconstruction of phi from neutron monitors or any published phi series
Fitted values of phi; fits over periods belong to hep-statistics (time-series inference)
Source terms (dark matter, pulsars) and galactic propagation; geomagnetic cutoffs; transients (Forbush decreases, solar energetic particles)
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no comparison with measured fluxes

capabilities.name: force-field-derivation
capabilities.scope: SymPy: F(T + |Z| phi) solves the zero-streaming equation with kappa proportional to rigidity, the characteristic invariant, the p^2 flux relation, the power-law closed forms in three energy kinds and their limits (analytic derivation, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: power-law-closed-form-benchmark
capabilities.scope: the hep-measurement force-field script (run as a process) against the closed forms: 90 synthetic points, 2 species, phi 0-1 GV, Ek_total, Ek_per_nucleon, rigidity, relative tolerance 1e-10; phi = 0 and demodulate round trip

capabilities.name: validity-and-limits
capabilities.scope: low-energy breakdown (about 300 MeV/n protons, 250 MeV/n alpha), no rigidity-dependent, time-dependent or charge-sign effects, phi-LIS degeneracy; sources read 2026-10-13 (models/heliospheric-modulation-models.md)

capabilities.name: other-modulation-models
capabilities.scope: convection-diffusion transport, drift and 1D-3D numerical models named and contrasted with the force field; none implemented or run; unverified context

capabilities.name: neutron-monitor-link
capabilities.scope: phi time series reconstructed from neutron monitors depend on the assumed LIS; unverified context, no method or series opened

capabilities.name: multi-period-phi-fits
capabilities.scope: by reference to skills/hep-statistics/references/time-series-inference.md (joint fits of several periods); this profile supplies conventions and validity
